name: Cortext Memory
description: Durable local memory for OpenClaw. Per-conversation-isolated context engine with an interrupt gate over streaming reasoning.

dbPath.description: Directory name for Cortext SQLite stores, under the agent directory.

memoryScope.description: Isolation boundary. 'session' (default): one store per conversation — safe when an agent serves multiple users. 'agent': persists across an agent's sessions (single-user agents only). 'global': one shared store.

focus.description: Cortext focus knob (F): retrieval breadth vs precision.

sensitivity.description: Cortext sensitivity knob (S): affective relaxation of the interrupt gate.

stability.description: Cortext stability knob (T): interrupt refractory period and boundary pacing.

recallLimit.description: Maximum recalled memories injected per assembly.

interruptGate.description: Run the live interrupt gate over streaming assistant/reasoning deltas.

ingestReasoning.description: Feed reasoning (thinking) deltas, not just visible answer text, into the gate.

forceRepass.description: On should_interrupt, request a revise via before_agent_finalize so the model reconsiders the current answer with recalled memory (one extra pass per trigger).

compactionMode.description: Cortext owns compaction (no summarizer LLM call). 'hybrid': keep system prompt + long-term recall + a verbatim tail of recent messages. 'full': keep system prompt + Cortext memory only (long-term recall plus the working-memory snapshot); the verbatim window shrinks to the current exchange.

protectTail.description: Hybrid mode: trailing messages kept verbatim after compaction (cut is walked back to a user-message boundary).
